Theme: opulent imperial gold carved palace frame with ruby corner jewels, calm pale ivory gold center. Style: polished hand-painted Q fantasy game art, friendly and elegant. Composition: perfectly square, perfectly flat top-down view, no perspective, decorative border only in outermost 9 percent on all sides, center 82 percent calm uniform low contrast almost empty surface on which software will draw a 9 by 9 grid. Match details at all four edges. No painted grid, no squares, no castles, no pieces, no characters, no typography, no text, no watermark.
